title: Destiny 2

custody.condition: Account-bound license on the archive Steam account. No physical media is part of this accession.

curatorNotes: Reserved for curator writing on Destiny 2 as a live-service MMO shooter digital holding.
collectionNotes: Ownership is digital only. The retained object is the Steam license. Official cover artwork has been entered from Steam library art; collection photography does not apply.

preservation.playableOn: Windows PC through Steam under archive custody
preservation.compatibility: Continued access requires the archive account, Steam’s support for the title, and Bungie online services.
preservation.concerns: Always-online live-service structure creates high preservation risk: vaulted campaigns, seasonal content rotation, and server dependency. No offline installer is held.
preservation.knownRevisions: Destiny 2 originally launched in 2017 outside Steam. The Steam PC edition is dated October 1, 2019 on the storefront. This accession records the licensed digital edition in custody under the Steam distribution path.
preservation.availability: Held as a permanent digital license on the archive Steam account while that custody and Bungie’s required services continue.

connections.futureReview: Reserved for future critical writing in Bloodsoaked Media.

stewardshipHistory.note: Steam library artwork filed under the Library accession path.
Catalog identity, authority references, and digital-holding documentation aligned for publication.

synopsis: Bungie’s Destiny 2 on Steam — retained as a permanent digital holding in the Destiny series.
